additional_info.body:
Dear Sakari, here is the promised analysis :D
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco

Product

Main Asset
:
Parkano
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
rKnB5p
Problem Description
: Missing Converters in DC4
Troubleshooting
: It seems that this error comes after a reboot, so the charger was working, a reboot was performed at 2am due to Autoreboot and the problem occurred.
From the looks of it, I believe that there 2 possibilities, either KF214 is constantly sending 12V to the converters or the power supply to the converters is not good (very unlikely), since we have the CAN address it's communicating well but just not powering ON.
My suggestion is that the next time this occurs we go to site and check these 12V leaving from KF214, please bring a spare KF214 in case this is true.
For future reference, your case number is
0408175
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,

additional_info.subject: ID0408175-DC/Si-D/FI-[rKnB5p] - Converter groups unable to do a fast shutdown CRM:00315002385
additional_info.body:
Hi guys, good morning.
Markus told me there were no sessions in DC3 and I can see that the FBK never goes to true on the QA231-232 as such it always fails in CableCheck.
This usually means that there is something wrong with the StateMonitor, KF214, which seems to be affecting also the Fast shutdown of DC4.
I recommend you to take a spare KF214 and CCS cable in case there is something wrong. I assume it won't be needed the CCS.
I will forward the ticket to your Queue.
Best regards,
Francisco
